snapshot.text: Tax-funded health system where state-funded services mainly cover emergencies, and the minister says a funding deficit persists. Main challenges are uneven hospital quality, healthcare funding and pay disputes. Hospital network reform was approved in July 2026.

priorities.title: Hospital network restructuring
priorities.text: The cabinet endorsed a plan in July 2026 to shift from five hospital tiers to three (local, regional, multi-specialty) from 2027, aiming to tackle uneven quality of care.

priorities.title: Increasing healthcare funding
priorities.text: The Kulbergs government lists raising healthcare funding among its social-sphere goals, alongside family support and a basic pension, while the health minister says budget room is limited.

priorities.title: Alcohol availability restrictions
priorities.text: Shorter sales hours, no instant online alcohol delivery and gambling-venue limits were introduced; an early WHO/Europe evaluation links them to a significant drop in alcohol deaths.
